description: A spacious farmhouse-style master bedroom with a striking vaulted ceiling that rises to a sharp gable peak. The walls are painted in a soft cool grey with clean white crown and trim. The ceiling slopes symmetrically on both sides, framing the room with architectural grandeur. A set of French doors with flanking sash windows dominates the back wall, dressed with medium grey rod-pocket curtains and white roman shades, with a lush green garden visible through the glass. On the left wall, a white painted brick fireplace with a simple wood mantel sits beneath a wall-mounted flatscreen, with a multi-pane casement window above. A cream upholstered wingback armchair with a striped toss pillow sits near the fireplace. The bed has a reclaimed barnwood headboard with a horizontal plank grain, dressed in white and ivory linen with grey accent cushions and a folded blanket at the foot. Dark nightstands flank the bed. The floor is pale natural oak hardwood with a white and grey patterned area rug. Natural daylight floods in warmly from the back windows and garden beyond. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal to slightly wide lens from the foot of the bed in a centered symmetrical wide establishing composition that shows the full gable ceiling, fireplace, and back wall.
